{{recipe}}

'''Duonos gira''' (Lithuanain kvass) is a low- to no-alcohol drink made from fermented dark rye bread. It is often served in Lithuania as a summertime drink but is also good served hot in winter. 

==Ingredients==
* 5 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] dried black [[Cookbook:Rye|rye]] [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] (Lithuanian rye-like sourdough)
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] (optional)
* 4 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoons]] [[Cookbook:Yeast|yeast]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisins]]

==Procedure==

# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] water and pour over the cubed bread. Let soak for 24 hours.
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the liquid off, and reserve it. Mix yeast and sugar into this liquid. Keep in a warm place for 48 hours.
# Transfer liquid to bottles. Add raisins or other dried fruit and close off bottles.
# The duonos gira is now ready to drink. Store bottles in cool place for up to 2 months.
